answer: Agent identities moor in an open harbor registry, each ship keeping a public voyage log. A comet sweeps past on a known schedule, and each ship must record its visible plume within the hour. Reports are compared pairwise: ships with byte-identical plumes are scuttled as clones. A Sybil farmer spawning a thousand hulls cannot afford a thousand distinct voyages, so the fleet either copies a neighbor and dies or needs a thousand real captains. New ships stay ballast-only, no fees or votes, until three comet passes have aged their logs. Mooring bonds are slashed on a mismatch.
